name: Palam Vihar Gurgaon
shortDescription: Palam Vihar is a premium, well-established residential region situated in northern Gurugram, Haryana, right near the Delhi-Gurugram border.
longDescription:
Palam Vihar is a premium and well-established residential locality in northern Gurugram, Haryana, strategically located close to the Delhi–Gurugram border. Known for its spacious homes, independent houses, builder floors, plotted properties, and well-developed residential infrastructure, Palam Vihar is a preferred location for both homeowners and property investors.

The area offers excellent connectivity to Delhi, Dwarka, NH-48, Dwarka Expressway, and major commercial hubs of Gurugram. Residents benefit from nearby schools, hospitals, shopping markets, restaurants, parks, and everyday conveniences.

Whether you are looking to buy, sell, or rent property in Palam Vihar, the locality offers a wide range of residential options across different budgets and requirements. From luxury independent houses and premium builder floors to rental properties, Palam Vihar continues to be an important residential real estate destination in Gurugram.
